== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill trainer]]s'''
* [[Zhao Di]] ([[Shing Jea Monastery]])
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Notes ==
* Bleeding will [[cover]] conditions inflicted by attack skills.
* If using with [[Apply Poison]], Poison will cover bleeding. If using with [[Poison Tip Signet]], the conditions apply in order, so bleeding will cover poison if Sharpen Daggers is applied second.
* Attacks while wielding daggers will trigger the bleeding, so [[Melee Attack]]s are included.
** Secondary targets for skills such as [[Golden Phoenix Strike]] or [[Death Blossom]] do NOT trigger the bleeding.
** Combine with [[Whirlwind Attack]] to apply bleeding on a large scale.
{{bug|If a [[Ranged attack|ranged]] weapon is swapped for daggers after the attack was made and before the projectile hit, Sharpen Dagger will count this projectile hit as a dagger attack}}

== Trivia ==
Before the [[Game updates/20090806|August 6, 2009 update]], this skill affected non-dagger attacks as well.
